interval_method: 95% paired-match-seed block bootstrap, 2000 resamples; hand ratios resample counts

style_definitions.open: hands with an open meld / hands
style_definitions.safe_choice: genbutsu against every riichi opponent, conditional on having a safe legal discard and not already being in riichi
style_definitions.shanten_backoff: chosen genbutsu worsens shanten versus best legal discard under the same condition, with at least two discard kinds; behavioral proxy, not inferred intent

experiment.main_analysis: equal-budget final checkpoints, two paired training seeds
experiment.secondary_analysis: best checkpoints chosen on validation only
experiment.opponents: fixed greedy/defensive/value mixture; no self-play in this controlled ablation

pooled_interval_note: Test-wall bootstrap conditional on the two fitted training seeds; not a population CI over retraining.
